concepts.gloss_en: "The fear of the LORD is his treasure" (Isaiah 33:6) — fear as a stored-up treasure/storehouse
"A woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised" (Proverbs 31:30) — fear as that which is praised; linked to the nose/smell

reason_for_human: These are two different biblical verses with different final words: אוֹצָרוֹ 'his treasure' (Isaiah 33:6) versus תִתְהַלָּל 'she shall be praised' (Proverbs 31:30). All five occurrences consistently cite one verse or the other, and each carries a distinct theme (treasure/storehouse of Holy Tongue vs. praise/nose/smell/prayer). Keeping them separate is correct.
